description: This file provides dynamic formatting for time differences, including calculating, formatting, and refreshing time interval displays in a Drupal project.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a computed time difference string in a HTML5 time element and sets up periodic refresh based on settings.

methods.name: refreshInterval
methods.description: Calculates the optimal refresh interval based on the current time difference and granularity.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a time difference in seconds into a human-readable string with specified granularity.
